title: N3on Toronto Caribana Carnival golf cart accident explained: What really happened?
summary_full: Popular Kick streamer N3on was involved in a golf cart accident during Toronto's Caribbean Carnival. The incident occurred on August 1st while N3on was livestreaming the event. N3on was a passenger and not driving the golf cart when the accident happened. An injured woman was taken for surgery and is reportedly recovering well. Several rumors about lawsuits and injuries have circulated online since the event.
